evidence: The robot holds the brown kettle by its top handle (the wrist view shows the handle between the fingers in all frames). It carries the kettle from the right part of the stove (8.0 s) over to the front camera-left burner (9.6-12.8 s). At 12.8 s the kettle is on or just above that burner in the left shoulder view but is still gripped, so the placement is not finished (no release yet). No flame is visible yet. This is normal progress. Stage 1 may count as done if the kettle is already resting on the grate.
